request.text: Prominent close dry foley of a flower nest opening with a small wooden winch. 0-.9s: thick petals curl shut with a full crisp leafy swish. .9-1.6s: vine rope tightens and wooden pegs lock with tactile ticks. 1.6-3.1s: petals steadily unfurl, a gentle wooden ratchet creaks. 3.1-3.6s: one distinct latch click and leaves settle.
